0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Apparently, highly flammable fuel sources and exploding monsters are a bad combination.

24.original: Survey the designated location and defeat any enemies that appear.

48.original: Where's a hunter when you need one?

49.original: Oh, hey there. Say, you seem like the wild critter-wrangling type. What do you say to a little honest work?

50.original: You see, down by the ceruleum pits, we've got ourselves something of an infestation. Cerule bombs, to be precise.

51.original: Now, with them being the flame-spewing, explode-at-the-drop-of-a-hat sons of salamanders that they are, if even one got into our fuel supplies, this whole place would be blown sky-high!

52.original: Until recently, I've always had a hunter friend of mine keep their numbers down, but he's, ah...temporarily incapacitated. I was thinking you could take his place. If so, there's a whole bunch of them a little ways south from here. Good hunting!

53.original: If you're having trouble finding them, just wait by one of the ceruleum pits, and they're sure to find <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>!

54.original: All done? How many were there?

55.original: Are you kidding? They must've invited every damn bomb and his cousin to join the party! Sounds like you got there just in time.

56.original: Of course, culling them the old-fashioned way's risky work, and it ain't easy finding someone with the necessary skills. I guess we'd better come up with a better plan to keep them at bay.

57.original: In any case, you've done us all a good turn, friend. I just knew I'd picked the right <hex:02080DE905FF0467616CFF0467757903> for the job!
